description: This file defines the GuidId class, a unique identifier based on Guid, including methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and caching.

classes.name: GuidId
classes.description: A sealed class representing a unique identifier based on Guid, implementing equality, comparison, serialization, and caching.

methods.name: GetNewGuidId
methods.description: Returns a new, randomly generated GuidId instance.

methods.name: GetGuidId
methods.description: Returns a GuidId instance corresponding to the provided Guid.

methods.name: FindOrCreateGuidId
methods.description: Finds or creates a GuidId for the given Guid, utilizing an internal cache.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this GuidId with another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this GuidId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Guid.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Checks if two GuidId instances are equal.

methods.name: operator !=
methods.description: Checks if two GuidId instances are not equal.
